_meta.purpose: Reference corpus for Feature 2 (section suggestion) in NEW_FEATURES.md. Complaint text is matched against the description + keywords of each entry by cosine similarity; the nearest entries are returned as ranked candidates.
_meta.disclaimer: ADVISORY ONLY. These mappings are a drafting aid for the investigating officer, not a legal determination. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 replaced the IPC with effect from 1 July 2024; offences before that date are still charged under the IPC, so both are carried here. Every suggestion must be verified by the IO or legal cell before a charge is framed.
_meta.editing: This file is data, not code. Add or correct entries here and restart the API; no code change is needed. Keep the description in the language a complainant would actually use - retrieval quality depends on it far more than on legal phrasing.

sections.title: Theft
sections.description: Dishonestly taking away movable property belonging to another person without consent. Complainant reports that cash, a mobile phone, a bicycle, ornaments or other belongings were stolen or went missing.

sections.title: Snatching
sections.description: Sudden forcible seizure of a chain, mobile phone, bag or ornament from a person, typically by offenders on a motorcycle who grab the item and speed away. Chain snatching from a pedestrian on the road.

sections.title: Motor vehicle theft
sections.description: Theft of a motorcycle, scooter, car or other vehicle parked on the road or in a compound. Vehicle missing from where the owner parked it.

sections.title: Pickpocketing
sections.description: Stealthily removing a purse, wallet or mobile phone from the pocket or handbag of a person in a crowded place such as a bus, market or railway station.

sections.title: Theft in a dwelling house
sections.description: Theft of property committed inside a house, building or tent used as a human dwelling, or in a place of worship.

sections.title: House-breaking to commit an offence
sections.description: Breaking into a house by force, breaking the lock, prying open a door, window or shutter in order to commit theft. Culprits broke open the door of a locked house and took away valuables.

sections.title: House-breaking by night
sections.description: House-breaking committed after sunset and before sunrise in order to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment. Burglary at night while the occupants were away or asleep.

sections.title: Shop burglary
sections.description: Breaking open the shutter or lock of a shop, godown or commercial establishment at night and stealing goods or cash from the premises.

sections.title: Murder
sections.description: Causing the death of a person by an act done with the intention of causing death. Deceased was killed by the accused.

sections.title: Murder for gain
sections.description: Murder committed in the course of robbery or for monetary gain, where the victim is killed to obtain money, property or valuables.

sections.title: Attempt to murder
sections.description: Doing an act with the intention of causing death, where the victim survives the attack. Accused attacked the victim with a weapon intending to kill but the victim survived with injuries.

sections.title: Dowry death
sections.description: Death of a woman by burns, bodily injury or otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of marriage, where she was subjected to cruelty or harassment for dowry.

sections.title: Causing death by negligence
sections.description: Causing the death of a person by a rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, such as a fatal road accident caused by rash driving.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
sections.description: Voluntarily causing bodily pain, disease or infirmity to another person. Complainant was beaten, slapped or assaulted during a quarrel.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
sections.description: Causing grievous hurt such as fracture of a bone or tooth, permanent disfiguration, loss of sight or hearing, or any injury endangering life or causing severe bodily pain for twenty days.

sections.title: Assault on a woman with intent to outrage her modesty
sections.description: Assaulting or using criminal force on a woman intending to outrage or knowing it likely to outrage her modesty. Complainant reports being touched inappropriately or molested.

sections.title: Assault to deter a public servant from duty
sections.description: Assaulting or using criminal force against a public servant while that person is discharging official duty, such as attacking a police officer, bus conductor or government official on duty.

sections.title: Kidnapping
sections.description: Taking or enticing a minor or a person of unsound mind out of the keeping of the lawful guardian without consent. A child is missing and suspected to have been taken away.

sections.title: Kidnapping for ransom
sections.description: Kidnapping or abducting a person and threatening to cause death or hurt in order to compel the payment of a ransom by the family or the government.

sections.title: Abduction of a woman
sections.description: Kidnapping or abducting a woman with intent to compel her to marry against her will or to force illicit intercourse.

sections.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
sections.description: Cheating a person and thereby dishonestly inducing them to deliver property or money. Complainant paid money on a false promise of a job, land, investment returns or goods that were never delivered.

sections.title: Criminal breach of trust
sections.description: Dishonest misappropriation or conversion of property entrusted to a person, such as an employee or agent misusing funds or goods placed in their care. Embezzlement of company money.

sections.title: Forgery
sections.description: Making a false document or false electronic record with intent to cause damage or injury, or to support a fraudulent claim. Fake signature, forged certificate or fabricated document.

sections.title: Forgery for the purpose of cheating
sections.description: Committing forgery with the intention that the forged document shall be used for the purpose of cheating another person.

sections.title: Cheating by personation using a computer resource
sections.description: Cheating by pretending to be someone else using a computer or phone. Caller posing as a bank official, customer care executive or officer obtained the OTP, card details or UPI PIN and transferred money from the account.

sections.title: Identity theft (fraudulent use of electronic signature or password)
sections.description: Fraudulently or dishonestly making use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of another person. Someone used the complainant Aadhaar, PAN, account credentials or created a fake profile in their name.

sections.title: Stalking or online harassment
sections.description: Following a woman or repeatedly contacting or monitoring her use of the internet, email or other electronic communication despite disinterest. Persistent messages, obscene posts or harassment on social media.

sections.title: Rioting
sections.description: Use of force or violence by an unlawful assembly, or by any member of it, in prosecution of a common object. A mob pelted stones, damaged vehicles and clashed on the road.

sections.title: Member of an unlawful assembly
sections.description: Being a member of an assembly of five or more persons whose common object is to commit an offence or to resist the execution of law. Unlawful gathering despite prohibitory orders.

sections.title: Promoting enmity between groups
sections.description: Promoting disharmony or feelings of enmity, hatred or ill-will between different religious, racial, linguistic or regional groups, including by speech or social media posts.

sections.title: Robbery
sections.description: Theft accompanied by violence or the fear of instant hurt, where the offender assaults or threatens the victim in order to take property.

sections.title: Dacoity
sections.description: Robbery committed jointly by five or more persons. An armed gang entered the premises and looted valuables.

sections.title: Extortion
sections.description: Intentionally putting a person in fear of injury and thereby dishonestly inducing them to deliver money or property. Demanding money under threat.

sections.title: Criminal intimidation
sections.description: Threatening a person with injury to their person, reputation or property with intent to cause alarm. Accused threatened the complainant with dire consequences.

sections.title: Mischief causing damage
sections.description: Causing wrongful loss or damage to property, such as damaging a vehicle, breaking windows, destroying a crop or damaging a compound wall.

sections.title: Criminal trespass
sections.description: Entering into property in the possession of another with intent to commit an offence or to intimidate, insult or annoy. Unauthorised entry into land or premises.

sections.title: Cruelty by husband or his relatives
sections.description: Subjecting a married woman to cruelty or harassment, including harassment for dowry, by her husband or his relatives.
